    • distanceFromPointToSquare

      public static double distanceFromPointToSquare(Point p, Square square)
      Calculates the shortest distance from a point to a square. This method calculates the distance between the point and each side of the square, then returns the smallest distance.
      Parameters:
      p - The point from which the distance is calculated.
      square - The square to which the distance is calculated.
      Returns:
      The shortest distance from the point to the square.
